# Saratoga Performing Arts Center (SPAC)

> > SPAC is a premier outdoor amphitheater in Saratoga Springs, NY, hosting world-class performances from the New York City Ballet, The Philadelphia Orchestra, and major concert artists.

Located in Saratoga Springs, SPAC serves as a cultural hub featuring the Broadview Stage amphitheater, the renowned Saratoga Jazz Festival, and educational programs through its School of the Arts. The venue partners with Live Nation for major touring concerts and maintains resident company relationships with leading classical performing arts organizations.

- Saratoga Performing Arts Center (SPAC)

- [Ticket Donation Requests | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/ticket-donation-requests): Ticket donation request process for 501c3 nonprofits and fundraising

## Festivals & Special Events

- [Saratoga Jazz Festival at Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/saratoga-performing-arts-center/saratoga-jazz-festival): 2026 Saratoga Jazz Festival featuring Patti LaBelle and Miles Electric Band
- [Farm Aid | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/events/farm-aid): Farm Aid concert event at Broadview Stage with parking and venue details

## Education & Classes

- [Adult Classes | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/education/school-of-the-arts/adult-classes): School of the Arts adult classes in dance, music, theatre, and ukulele
- [ONLINE The Ageless Dancer: Ballet Barre & Balance | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/events/the-ageless-dancer-ballet-barre-balance-online): Online ballet barre and balance fitness class for seniors
- [Pop-Up Choir | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/events/pop-up-choir-2): Free all-ages Pop-Up Choir community singing event, no audition required

## Concert Events

- [Phish | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/events/phish): Phish concert event page with ticket sales and Live Nation ground rules
- [Vampire Weekend | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/events/vampire-weekend): Vampire Weekend concert at Broadview Stage with Live Nation ground rules

- [Primus and Coheed and Cambria | Saratoga Performing Arts Center](https://spac.org/events/live-nation-primus-and-coheed-and-cambria): Primus and Coheed and Cambria concert with Live Nation venue information
